description: This file defines a utility function to ensure a plugin ID is allowlisted within a configuration object, specifically manipulating the allowlist array within plugins.

methods.description: Ensures that a specified plugin ID is included in the allowlist of plugins within the given configuration. If the allowlist is missing or the plugin ID is already present, the original config is returned; otherwise, a new config with the plugin ID added is returned.
